text:
Ryan: I swear my YAML is doing passive-aggressive breakups now. It removed me from the list without a goodbye.
Marta: haha what did it say in the breakup note?
Ryan: it wrote:```yaml
relationship: "it's not you, it's my indentation"
status: single
reasons:
  - inconsistent-tabs: true
  - secret-merge-conflict: yes
```
Sam: semver probably slid into its DMs with a major version bump. :laughing:
Olga: commit message idea: `fix: apologize to YAML for unexpected tabs` :joy:
Ryan: build error when I tried to load it:```error
parse error: found a tab where a space should've been (line 3)
```
Marta: quick fix: replace tabs with two spaces and add this at the top to silence feelings:```bash
sed -i 's/\t/  /g' confusing.yml
```
Sam: life tip: always pin your dependencies and your feelings. :neutral_face:
Olga: also: never trust semver after midnight. it's when it does major things.
deploy-bot: deploy started for branch `hotfix/yaml-therapy` by Ryan — CI: all checks passed ✅
Ryan: :tada: thanks team. YAML accepted my apology and is back on speaking terms.
Marta: can we get a bot that sends flowers when a config file is fixed?
Sam: +1 to `config-flowers-bot` for morale.
Olga: PR title: `chore: make YAML less passive-aggressive`
Ryan: merging now, feel free to add better commit poetry later. :bouquet:
